A restless soul, the "Pocong," wanders the halls of an abandoned hospital. As an investigator, uncover the truth, collect lost belongings, and perform the ritual to lay the spirit to rest.

Will you soothe the soul, or become the hospital’s next target...?

📝 HOW TO PLAY:

🔍 INVESTIGATE: Search for items required for the ritual.
🏃 SURVIVE: Run and hide from the Pocong roaming the corridors!

games.name: HOUR 12 🕛 [ANOMALY]
games.desc:
💤You fell asleep at your desk. It's late. Time to go home. 

⏰HOUR 12 is a first-person anomaly horror game set in an endless 1970s office. 

Every room should look exactly like the last one. If it does, keep walking through the EXIT. If anything is different — turn around and go back through the door you came in.

Every right call moves the clock forward an hour. 
A wrong one sends you back to 1:00. 
Reach 12 and you can clock out.

• 100+ anomalies to discover
• Single player & CO-OP modes. 
• An 'endless' mode unlocks after your first shift.
• Headphones recommended.

Inspired The Exit 8 style anomaly games.

games.name: [⛏️] Gilrock
games.desc:
Gilrock is a 2.5D mining game about hunting rare ores, from odds 1/20 to 1/2,000,000,000. The caverns are procedurally generated, meaning a fresh mine every run! Aside from just mining, you'll also find minigames and varied side-content.

⚠️ [Beta Release]
- The game is in active development with many planned changes.

🎮 [Game Features]
- Craft Pickaxes, Gears (like Speed Coils and Antimatter Bombs), paired with Consumables for you to rip apart the caverns. With more unlocks as you progress!
- Chase unfathomably rare collectibles, tracked in a 244+ item-long Compendium!
- Hybrid between manual/idle play with a built-in AFK Mode!

❓ [How to Play]
- Take the Mine Lift to the caverns.
- Mine manually, or go idle with AFK Mode.
- On PC, press [CTRL] to enable Smart Cursor.
